name: Lume
description: Lume's `upgrade` CLI command delegates to the imported upgrade implementation for the current project and awaits it. The reviewed command file does not itself establish the remote CDN, module execution, or signature/checksum behavior of that delegated implementation.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot rather than historical release re-verification; the imported upgrade implementation, CDN transport, and any signature/checksum behavior were not independently connected to this command body.
